fix_plan: In ExplorationScene.create() NPC render loop (around line 930), after constructing nameLabel with setOrigin(0.5, 0), measure nameLabel.width and clamp the label's x position so its left/right edges stay within [labelPad, roomPxWidth - labelPad] using Phaser.Math.Clamp. roomPxWidth = room.width * TILE. This auto-detects edge cases for any NPC near a room boundary regardless of name length, without modifying roomData.json or per-NPC content. Origin/tween/completed-alpha behavior preserved; only the x coordinate is adjusted post-construction.
diff_summary: Added 9-line clamp block after nameLabel construction in NPC render loop: measures nameLabel.width and clamps x to keep label inside roomPxWidth - padding on both edges.
notes: Clamp is symmetric (handles both left and right overflow). Guard `if (maxX >= minX)` skips the clamp if the label is wider than the room itself (degenerate case) so we don't pin it off-canvas. Boss text and checkmark labels above NPC head are short enough not to overflow and were left untouched per minimum-fix rule.

fix_plan: Audit of BattleEncounterScreen, ChoicePrompt, and EducationalItemModal showed ChoicePrompt was already fully wired (open + select). Two real silent player actions remained: (1) BattleEncounterScreen's initial mount (phase='dialogue' open) had no SFX and the dialogue-advance path (SPACE keypress, overlay click, dialogue panel click, CONTINUE button on feedback) was silent; close on unmount was also silent. Fix wires sfx_interact at subtle volumes (0.35 open, 0.3 dialogue advance, 0.4 CONTINUE, 0.2 rate=0.9 close) using the existing eventBridge.REACT_PLAY_SFX pattern already imported in both files. No new SFX keys, no new files, no new abstractions; volumes match the per-action guidance in the ticket and existing house style elsewhere in the codebase.
